name: youtube-transcript-dossier
description: Production skill for converting YouTube video transcripts into structured dossiers with metadata, timestamped key topics, quotes, takeaways, and follow-up items.
abstract: Production skill for converting YouTube video transcripts into structured dossiers. Fetches video metadata via yt-dlp and transcripts via youtube-transcript-api, then synthesizes a dossier with timestamped key topics, notable quotes, takeaways, and follow-up items. Supports language preference, cookie-based auth for restricted videos, and JSON/text/VTT output formats.
